read.title: Vine Program Update
read.text:
Team,

Here is a quick update on our Vine program for the new Peptide Eye Cream. We enrolled 30 units on November 3, and so far we have received 22 reviews with an average star rating of 4.4.

Most Vine Voices praised the light texture, but four reviewers said the tube was hard to squeeze. We are sharing this feedback with the packaging team.

Since early reviews have clearly helped our conversion rate, it might be worth enrolling the matching night cream next month.

Minsu

write.en: Write a short message suggesting that your team enroll a new sun stick with only three reviews in the Vine program.
write.model: Hi team, our new sun stick has only three reviews so far. It might be worth enrolling 20 units in the Vine program this week. Early reviews could improve our star rating and conversion before the holiday sale. What do you think?
